summary: SIMPPLE Ltd., a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing interim unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2025 and 2026, signed by Executive Chairman Kelvin Lee. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed; the excerpt is solely XBRL-tagged interim accounts. There is no special-situation event to arbitrage—this is an ordinary periodic reporting filing. What to watch is the 20-F/annual cycle and any subsequent material-event 6-K, not deal mechanics.
